# Timeline for the Implementation of the EU AI Act
The EU’s AI Act legislation applies progressively, with a full roll-out of the main application milestones foreseen by 2 August 2028. The timeline takes into account the AI Act amendments introduced by Digital Omnibus on AI.
1. 01 Aug 2024
  Entry into force
2. 02 Feb 2025
  General provisions (definitions & AI literacy) and prohibitions apply
3. 02 Aug 2025
  Rules for general-purpose AI apply and governance must be in place

...

5. 02 Dec 2026
  New prohibitions + Article 50(2) transition apply **

# EU AI Act: Transparency and Enforcement Rules Take Effect as High-Risk Regime Is Deferred
The European Union’s AI Act entered a new phase on August 2, 2026, marking two years since its entry into force. Most immediately, the transparency obligations in Article 50 now apply to a broad range of AI systems and their providers and deployers, and the AI Act’s enforcement machinery is operational for obligations that are already in force.

answer: The AI Act applies progressively, with a full roll-out by 2 August 2028 [2]. The EU AI Act entered into force on 1 August 2024 [3]. The prohibitions, definitions and provisions related to AI literacy became applicable on 2 February 2025 [2]. Rules on governance and obligations for general-purpose AI models became applicable on 2 August 2025 [2]. Transparency requirements under Article 50 and measures in support of innovation apply as of 2 August 2026 [2]. Enforcement of the AI Act starts on 2 August 2026 [2]. Prohibitions on AI systems generating non-consensual sexual deepfakes and child sexual abuse material start to apply on 2 December 2026 [1]. Obligations regarding high-risk systems listed in Annex III enter into force on 2 December 2027 [2]. Obligations for high-risk AI systems embedded in regulated products listed in Annex I enter into force on 2 August 2028 [2]. Member States should have at least one AI regulatory sandbox per country operational by 2 August 2027 [1].
